content:
🏆 Grateful for the Learning, Proud of the Experience!

I’m delighted to share that I have successfully participated in “The Litigation Studio – 4 Days Moot Training Workshop”, organised by YouthLexHub held from 27th–30th August 2026.

The workshop provided valuable insights into Mooting, Legal Research, Memorial Writing, and Oratory Skills, with insightful sessions led by Areeha Ijaz , Muhammad Umer, Ameera Khurshid & Ayesha Khan.

As a law student, experiences like these go beyond certificates they help build the confidence, research skills, advocacy techniques, and courtroom perspective that are essential for the legal profession. ⚖️

A big thank you to YouthLexHub and all the speakers for creating such an enriching learning experience. Looking forward to putting these learnings into practice and continuing to grow as a future legal professional! ✨
